Package game.positions.area

Class AreaFactory

java.lang.Object
game.positions.area.AreaFactory
public class AreaFactory extends Object
Builds the Areas the game uses: the named shapes it already relies on (within a radius, adjacent, centred on a tile, the whole map), plus of(List) for any custom list of tiles a caller has put together itself. Every Area this factory builds carries the same RandomUtils this factory was given, so random tile choices made on it share one source of randomness with the rest of the game.

    • within

      public Area within(Location centre, int radius)
      Builds the area of tiles within the given distance of a Location, not including the Location itself. Distance is measured as a king moves on a chessboard, so the area is a square around the centre.
      Parameters:
      centre - the Location at the middle of the area
      radius - how many tiles away from the centre the area reaches
      Returns:
      the tiles within the radius
